In the Kikuka-sho, Special Week's sole 
rival was Seiun Sky. That was the palpable 
mood shared by both the media and the 
public.

Meanwhile, looking at King Halo's running, 
the Trainer was convinced of one thing: 
Her style was meant for sprint distances.

Was entering the long-distance Kikuka Sho 
truly the right choice? When the Trainer 
confides this doubt, King Halo quietly 
nods in agreement.

"Because I'm a first-class Umamusume." She 
looked cornered as she insisted that to be 
acknowledged, she had to shine on the 
classic Triple Crown's royal road...
